responsibility: This autogenerated companion to c6x-tables.opt records documentation URL suffixes for the generated C6X option-table entries, chiefly the -march= enum values derived from c6x-isas.def. It is consumed by GCC’s option/documentation tooling rather than the backend itself, linking internal option definitions to the corresponding HTML manual anchors so generated help or diagnostics can refer from parsed architecture-value tables to the right C6X options documentation.
